edit.description: receives the author-facing rules with no kind/field/clause/refusal home

summary: author-facing rules stranded in exported-API TSDoc move to a delivered home; the TSDoc keeps the description
acceptance: every must/never/prefer/use-X-not-Y sentence addressed to an author in exported TSDoc lives in kind or field guidance, a clause's guidance, an emit/SDK refusal message, or the counsel rule; net-neutral or negative lines; SDK gate green
notes: A fold: no tests[]/pins[] (SDK-only). Internal implementation comments are out of scope; only counsel to a program author moves.
